crossRefs.note: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only…

translations.web: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.
translations.bsb: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
translations.kjv: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
translations.asv: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees, And brake the trees of their borders.
